title: Week 1 · Getting started
description: A made-up quiz used by the smoke tests.

questions.question: The smoke tests open every page of the app.
questions.explanation: The point of the smoke tests is to catch a broken page before a release, so they open every page of the app and check that it shows something useful. If a page crashed or came up empty, the test would fail and the release would wait.

questions.question: What do the smoke tests run on?
questions.explanation: They run on a small made-up semester that is copied to a temporary folder first. Your own semester is never used, so a test can't change or leak your notes or scores, and eClass is never contacted, so the tests work without a key or a network.

questions.question: Which steps are in the demo diagram? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Data flows from the demo semester into the app, and the smoke test drives the app in a browser to check it. All three steps are part of that chain, so "None of the above" is wrong.
